adjudication.rationale: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts, the recurring-event deletion path still does `const bookingRef = updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"));` inside the loop over `updatedBookings` (now bookings can have multiple `_calendar` references after this refactor). That means for each remaining occurrence it deletes only the first calendar reference, so additional hosts’ calendar events (additional `_calendar` references) are not deleted. Additionally, this recurring deletion block is nested under `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)` while also iterating `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(..._calendar)`, so the same deletions can be repeated per top-level reference.
